blocks.prompt: 18 If the roots of the equation \(a(b - c)x^{2} + b(c - a)x + c(a - b) = 0\) are equal, prove that \(a, b, c\) are in H.P.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh quadratic equation ka proof hai jis ke roots barabar hain. Seedha discriminant lagayein to hisaab lamba ho jata hai, is liye ek chaalaak raasta lete hain.
Teeno coefficients ka jama zero hai, to \(x = 1\) zaroor ek root hai. Roots barabar hain, to dono roots 1 hain.
Plan: roots ka product 1 rakho; is se seedha \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\) nikal aata hai, jo H.P. ki shart hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a(b - c)x^{2} + b(c - a)x + c(a - b) = 0\) ke roots barabar hain (\(a(b - c) \ne 0\)).
Saabit karna hai: \(a, b, c\) H.P. mein hain.
Tareeqa: Jis quadratic ke coefficients ka jama zero ho, us ka ek root \(x = 1\) hota hai. Phir roots ka product \(\frac{C}{A}\) use karenge.

Coefficients jama karein
\[a(b - c) + b(c - a) + c(a - b)\]
\[= ab - ac + bc - ab + ac - bc = 0\]
Kyun: Brackets kholein to \(ab\), \(ac\), \(bc\) har ek ek dafa plus aur ek dafa minus aata hai, sab kat jate hain.

Is liye \(x = 1\) root hai
\[a(b - c) + b(c - a) + c(a - b) = 0\]
Kyun: Equation mein \(x = 1\) rakhein to \(x^{2} = 1\) aur \(x = 1\), aur bilkul coefficients ka jama bachta hai, jo zero hai. Yani \(x = 1\) equation ko satisfy karta hai.

Dono roots 1 hain
\[\alpha = \beta = 1\]
\[\alpha\beta = 1\]
Kyun: Roots barabar hain aur ek root 1 hai, to doosra bhi 1.

Roots ka product lagayein
\[\alpha\beta = \dfrac{c(a - b)}{a(b - c)} = 1\]
\[c(a - b) = a(b - c)\]
Kyun: \(Ax^{2} + Bx + C = 0\) mein roots ka product \(\frac{C}{A}\) hota hai. Yahan \(C = c(a - b)\) aur \(A = a(b - c)\).
Dhyan dein: Product \(\frac{C}{A}\) hai aur jama \(-\frac{B}{A}\); in dono ko ulta na karein.

Tarteeb dein
\[ac - bc = ab - ac\]
\[2ac = ab + bc = b(a + c)\]
\[b = \dfrac{2ac}{a + c}\]
Kyun: Brackets khole, \(ac\) wali terms ek taraf (\(ac + ac = 2ac\)) aur \(b\) wali doosri taraf, phir \(b\) common nikala aur \((a + c)\) se divide kiya.

Nateeja
Kyun: \(b = \frac{2ac}{a + c}\) ka matlab hai ke \(b\), \(a\) aur \(c\) ka H.M. hai, is liye \(a, b, c\) H.P. mein hain.
Tasdeeq (discriminant wala raasta): \(B^{2} - 4AC = b^{2}(c - a)^{2} - 4ac(b - c)(a - b) = (ab + bc - 2ac)^{2}\). Barabar roots ke liye yeh zero hona chahiye, yani \(2ac = b(a + c)\) \(\checkmark\). Dono raaste ek hi jawab dete hain.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(a, b, c\) H.P. mein hain.
